name: Retool Admin REST API
description: The Retool API enables Retool admins to programmatically manage different aspects of their organization, including users, groups, permissions, folders, spaces, and source control settings. Authentication uses Bearer tokens with scope-based permissions. The base URL is your Retool instance domain (e.g., https://your-org.retool.com/api/v2).
